title: Hardware wallet manufacturers report surge in demand
content:
TL;DR: A surge in hardware wallet demand signals a critical shift towards individual sovereignty, reinforcing Bitcoin's role as the ultimate tool for self-custody in an uncertain world. This move by transactors to secure their holdings off-exchange directly bolsters the network's decentralized ethos, even as Bitcoin's foundational security, anchored by a current hashrate of 951.53 EH/s and a robust difficulty of 146.47 T, continues its relentless operation. For the vigilant, this is an urgent call to action: audit your security practices and understand the profound implications of true ownership.

The Report

In a significant development echoing through the digital asset landscape, leading hardware wallet manufacturers are reporting an unmistakable surge in demand for their products. Companies like Ledger, Trezor, and Coldcard have indicated a marked increase in sales volumes over recent weeks, with some citing double-digit percentage growth. This uptick is not merely a seasonal blip; it reflects a deeper, more fundamental shift
